$schema.description: Path or URL to Sergeant's unit JSON Schema.

extends.description: Relative preset file(s) whose settings are merged beneath this unit.

platform.description: Target runtime platform (e.g. `neutral`, `browser`, `node`, `native`, or an integration-registered platform). Can be inferred automatically from `boundaries.classify` `{env}`.

private.description: When true, forbids other workspace units from importing this unit.

visibility.description: Who may import this unit: `public`, `subtree` (same parent folder), `internal` (none), or an explicit array of allowed unit names/selectors.

tags.description: Architectural tags used by `boundaries` rules and layers.

allowDeps.description: Exclusive allowlist of tags or unit names this unit may import in production files.

boundaries.description: Package-level boundary overrides for this unit.

allow.description: Extra workspace selectors this unit may import.

forbid.description: Direct targets forbidden to this unit.

forbidTransitive.description: Transitive tags, packages, or capabilities forbidden to this unit.

forbidExternal.description: Banned external packages mapped to replacement hints.

allowTypeOnly.description: Exempt `import type` on this unit's boundary checks.

maxExternalDeps.description: Maximum third-party runtime dependencies allowed in this unit.

needs.description: Workspace service runtimes this unit connects to (started automatically by `sgt dev` and integration tests).

dependencies.description: Direct workspace dependencies audited and autofixed by `sgt doctor`.

inputs.description: Extra unit-relative files hashed into this unit's build/test keys.

uncached.description: Disable caching for this whole unit (`true`) or matching unit-relative globs.

typescript.description: Unit-specific compiler options merged into generated editor configs.

run.description: Command to execute (shell string or argv array). Supports ${root}, ${unit}, ${name}, ${out}, ${exe}, and ${<unit>:build} tokens.

inputs.description: Input file globs hashed into the task cache key (prefix `!` to negate).

outputs.description: Output paths captured from the task into the content cache.

dependsOn.description: Prerequisite tasks (`^task`, `<unit>:<task>`, `build:<unit>`, `check`, `test`, or sibling task name).

into.description: Directory where generated outputs are materialized before checks, tests, and builds.

env.description: Environment variables set for the task (array of KEY=VALUE strings or object map).

passThroughEnv.description: Host environment variables forwarded without being hashed into the cache key.

tools.description: External tools required by this task (resolved and hashed into the cache key).

cache.description: Whether to cache task results (defaults to true for isolated tasks, false for live/watch).

check.description: When true, runs this task automatically as a verification gate during `sgt check`.

mode.description: Execution mode: `isolated` (hermetic snapshot, cached), `live` (workspace cwd, uncached by default), or `watch` (continuous long-running process).

lane.description: Test lane that owns this task when running `sgt test --type <lane>`.

tasks.description: Unit-scoped tasks run via `sgt run <unit>:<task>` or workspace fan-out `sgt run <task>`.
